dog.description_text:
Meet Pumpkin! 🧡 Our little 22 lb, 3-year-old girl recently joined Every Last One Rescue after her family had to surrender her due to a move to a home that doesn’t allow pets. Pumpkin is friendly and outgoing, and she previously lived with adults, children, dogs, and cats!

We can’t wait to get to know this sweet girl better and share more about her personality as she settles into foster care.

Check back soon for updates on Pumpkin!
dog.name: Pumpkin
